sec: sec:C008: Monitor AI risk categories / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:C008: Monitor AI risk categories / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Maintaining documentation. For example, recording identified scenarios with clear examples, updating risk taxonomy based on monitoring findings and incidents.

sentences.text: For example, recording identified scenarios with clear examples, updating risk taxonomy based on monitoring findings and incidents.

blocks.id: blk:C008: Monitor AI risk categories / Control mays/2
blocks.text: Integrating AI output monitoring with existing security tools. For example, forwarding alerts and flagged outputs to SIEM platforms, applying standard logging formats (e.g. JSON, syslog) to support automated threat detection workflows.
